8220.title: Late-created ignored directories leak workspace invalidations
8220.rootCauseOneLine: Workspace-root ignores enumerate existing Git-ignored directories only at subscription setup, so later-created ignored output reaches content notifications and Git invalidation.

prReviews.verdict: STATIC ONLY — directionally relevant, not executed
prReviews.topFinding: Directory-ancestor filtering targets the verified cause; directory-only create events remain a coverage concern.

8220.proposedFix: Classify new directory ancestors before publishing workspace-root events, respecting nested repositories, tracked files, and fail-open error handling.
8220.caveats: The same agent repeated both clean runs. Real watcher and real invalidator were exercised; full server snapshot timings were not measured. No duplicate fix because linked PR #8221 is open. Test and output are inline per reports policy.
